listingUrl.title: Product page URL
listingUrl.description: The live product listing to check the claims against (http or https).

claimTexts.title: Claims to check
claimTexts.description: What the seller says, one claim per line. Examples: "price $1,749.99", "new", "in stock", "2-year warranty", "30-day returns".

claims.title: Batch: claims on many pages (advanced)
claims.sectionCaption: Advanced: many listings in one run
claims.description: A list of {id, text, evidence_url} objects, one per claim, each with its own page. Optional field and value skip text parsing. Used together with the fields above if both are given.
